presentation_title: Exploring a Few Features in Koha
learning_objectives: Manage basic library operations using the Koha Library Management System.
prerequisites: Basic computer usage and familiarity with web browsers.

slides.title: Title Slide
content: Exploring a Few Features in Koha
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Exploring a Few Features in Koha.
slides.image_prompt: Title slide with Koha logo and tutorial title.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
content: Manage basic library operations using the Koha Library Management System.
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to manage basic library operations.
You will use the Koha Library Management System.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you will need access to a Koha instance.
You will also need a web browser.
I am using Firefox browser.
slides.image_prompt: Icons for a web browser and a generic computer screen.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, learners should have basic computer usage skills.
They should also be familiar with navigating web pages.
slides.image_prompt: Person using a computer, showing basic web browsing.

slides.title: Introduction to Koha
slides.narration:
Koha is an open-source integrated library system.
It helps libraries manage their collections efficiently.
It is used worldwide by various types of libraries.
slides.image_prompt: Koha logo, library interior with bookshelves.

slides.title: Logging in to Koha
slides.narration:
Let us begin by logging into Koha.
Open your web browser.
Type your Koha URL in the address bar.
Press Enter.
Enter your username and password.
Then, click the Log in button.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshot of Koha login page with username and password fields highlighted.

slides.title: Adding a New Patron
slides.narration:
Now, let us add a new patron to the system.
On the Koha dashboard, click on the Patrons module.
Then, click on New patron.
Select the appropriate patron category.
Fill in the required details.
These include first name and surname.
Click Submit.
slides.image_prompt: Sequence of screenshots: Koha dashboard with Patrons module highlighted, New patron button, patron details form, and Submit button.

slides.title: Searching the Catalog
content: Type search term (e.g., 'The Lord of the Rings')
Press Enter or click search button
slides.narration:
Next, we will search for an item.
It is in the library catalog.
Click on the Catalog module from the main menu.
Locate the search bar.
Type a book title or author name.
For example, type 'The Lord of the Rings'.
Press Enter or click the search button.
Observe the search results.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshots: Catalog module highlighted, search bar with example text, and search results page.

slides.title: Checking Out an Item
slides.narration:
Let us now check out a book.
It is for our new patron.
Click on the Circulation module.
Scan or type the patron ID.
Then, scan or type the item barcode.
Koha will display the checkout confirmation.
Click Confirm.
slides.image_prompt: Screenshots: Circulation module highlighted, patron ID input, item barcode input, and checkout confirmation screen.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
With this, we come to the end of this tutorial.
Let us summarise.
We learned how to log in to Koha.
We added a new patron.
We also searched the catalog.
Finally, we checked out an item.
slides.image_prompt: Summary slide with key points listed.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Log in to your Koha instance.
Add another new patron with different details.
Check out that book to your new patron.
slides.narration:
As an assignment, please do the following.
Log in to your Koha instance.
Add another new patron with different details.
Search for a different book.
Then, check out that book to your new patron.
